description: Official tax tables for a country and year: income tax bands, allowances, employee and employer social security rates and thresholds, and for many countries corporate, property, transfer and other taxes, each with its official source and the date it was checked. Available for all 41 countries, including those without calculations. Filter with group or sections for long tables.

country.description: Country short code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in lower case; the UK is "uk", "gb" also works), e.g. "us", "uk", "ca", "de", "in", "au", "nz", or the English name. Older keys such as "new-zealand" also work. See list_countries.

region.description: Regional table, e.g. a US state (ca), Canadian province (qc), UK nation (scotland), Swiss canton, Spanish community.

year.description: Tax year, e.g. "2026" or "2025-26". Default: latest.

name: get_tax_tables

attribution.description: Always "Data by CalcBloc"; show it with the figures.

calcblocUrl.description: The calcbloc.com page for this result.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

sources.description: Official sources for the rates used.

truncated.description: True when only the section index is returned; call again with group or sections.
